subject: MAP kickoff and acceptance QA: success indicators, exit gate rubric, timeline
messages:
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: alicia.gomez@clearpathhealth.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff and acceptance QA: success indicators, exit gate rubric, timeline

Alicia,

Thanks again for the time today. As promised I am attaching a first draft of the Mutual Action Plan and a companion CSV with candidate acceptance tests. High level asks for this thread:

1) Confirm the evaluation success signals that are must have vs nice to have
2) Flag any security or data residency blockers for VPC/private deployment testing in week three
3) Agree on a single point of contact for procurement milestones and signature cadence

Quick summary of our proposed cadence (detailed in attached MAP):
- Week 0  Kickoff and baseline instrumentation access
- Week 1  Integration smoke tests and sample workload run
- Week 2  Latency and throughput profiling, KV cache validation
- Week 3  Quantization/approximation checks and cost per 1M token validation
- Week 4  Acceptance test run, decision review, go/no-go

Example success indicators (please review in the attached PDF):
- Average p95 latency for 256-token requests < 220ms
- Concordance on 200 prompt evaluation set >= 92% vs baseline model outputs
- No data exfil concerns in the audit log review

Attachments: 20261014-Redwood_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf, eval-acceptance-tests.csv

Proposed next step: Can we lock in a 30 minute checkpoint Friday 10/16 to go through the acceptance tests and finalize the procurement milestone dates.

Thanks,

Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
Mobile: 415-555-0127
From: alicia.gomez@clearpathhealth.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@clearpathhealth.com
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 08:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff and acceptance QA: success indicators, exit gate rubric, timeline

Jonas,

Appreciate the draft and the clear cadence. Quick reactions after a first pass with the engineering and compliance leads:

- Success indicators: the p95 latency threshold looks reasonable but we need a p50 target included for user-experience checks. Also could we add a memory/KV eviction observation point as a signal for steady state behavior
- Data residency: we cannot ship test logs outside of the us-east-1 region. Do you support a private VPC connector for the pilot or will that come later in Dedicated?
- Acceptance tests: procurement asked that the acceptance tests include an explicit regression checklist and owner for each test case so there is zero ambiguity on passing vs failing.

Procurement note: we prefer signature in DocuSign after the go/no-go review. Our procurement lead, David Chen, will own that milestone. I copied procurement on this thread.

We can make the Friday 10/16 checkpoint as long as you can provide the updated MAP with p50 target and an ownership column in the CSV. Alicia

Alicia Gomez
Head of Platform Engineering
Clearpath Health
alicia.gomez@clearpathhealth.com
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: alicia.gomez@clearpathhealth.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff and acceptance QA: success indicators, exit gate rubric, timeline

Hi Alicia,

Thanks for the quick read and the procurement heads up. Jonas and I updated the MAP and the CSV per your asks. Changes attached and summarized below:

- Added p50 target of 95ms for 256-token baseline requests
- Added KV steady state observation check with owner labeled as infra test owner
- Expanded acceptance CSV with owner column, pass/fail criteria, and a short regression checklist per test
- Noted constraint on us-east-1 log residency and included a VPC smoke test step to confirm log egress controls in Week 1

We will bring the revised artifacts to the 30 minute checkpoint today. If David Chen wants to be on the call for the procurement milestone discussion we can include him.

Attachments: 20261016-Redwood_MAP_v1_1.pdf, eval-acceptance-tests_v2.csv

Marissa Cole
Director Solutions
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: alicia.gomez@clearpathhealth.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, procurement@clearpathhealth.com
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff and acceptance QA: success indicators, exit gate rubric, timeline

All,

Thanks for circulating the updated MAP and tests and for being flexible on the residency requirement. David Chen joined our checkpoint and approved the procurement timeline contingent on the acceptance run results. Summary from our side:

- We agree to the timeline with the caveat that any critical security findings during the Week 1 smoke or Week 3 audit will pause the run and trigger an emergency change window
- We will run the acceptance CSV v2 tests in a controlled window on 2026-11-10; service agreement for that window will be DocuSigned within 48 hours of a successful acceptance run
- Please include the final test ownership matrix and the runbook for pausing and remediation steps in the MAP before 2026-11-01

Next steps for Redwood: provide the final MAP that includes the pause/remediation runbook, and confirm the DocuSign recipient for the go/no-go milestone.

Regards,

Alicia

On behalf of Clearpath Health procurement: David Chen <david.chen@clearpathhealth.com>
